snippet.title: Humblets - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Humblets is a cozy adventure for 1-4 players where you explore a charming procedural world. Pack your tent and embark on a journey as you craft, decorate, befriend magical creatures and solve challenges with the magic of cards. No pressure, just peaceful exploration and fireside stories!

✨ Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3694600/Humblets/
✨ Support us on Kickstarter: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/berrybite/humblets
